newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Semicon June sales down 2.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Semicon June sales down 2.2 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's microchip giant Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co said on Thursday its June sales edged down 2.2 percent to T$3.452 billion from T$3.531 billion a year earlier.
But its June sales were up 10.3 percent from May, the company said in a statement.
In January-June, the firm's accumulated sales reached T$16.886 billion, down 20.7 percent from a year ago, it said.
Its January-June sales were in line with its sales target for the first half and had achieved 41.6 percent of its 1997 sales target, it said.
In late June, Taiwan Semiconductor raised 1997 net profit forecast by 60.9 percent to T$14.72 billion. It also increased its 1997 sales target by 15.4 percent to T$40.64 billion.
The company's capacity will increase 30 percent in the second half over the first half of this year, company spokesman and vice-president Y.C. Huang said in the statement.

"As demand from customers is very strong, the company expects that the output capacity will continue to be fully utilised in the second half, and hence the sales revenue will grow to account for 60 percent of the 1997 sales revenue," Huang said. -- Taipei newsroom (886-2-5080815)
